name: Ampulic Mass
effect: When destroyed, add +1 AP at your next Refresh. Does not trigger Sudden Death.

name: Mountain Howler
effect: When this creature attacks, it gains +1 ATK.

name: Blackened Dino
effect: Piercing — damage is dealt even if blocked.

name: Shielded Scientist
effect: This creature may block twice per combat, but takes damage equal to the total ATK it absorbed.

name: Jester Twill
effect: When summoned, select a creature on the field and reduce its ATK or DEF by 1. (Min 1)

name: Unpaid Intern
effect: If a creature you control would be destroyed, you may send this card from the field to the discard pile in its place.

name: Living Bomb
effect: Destroy this creature after it attacks.

name: Splodey
effect: If this creature attacks or is attacked, both creatures are destroyed.

name: Analog Dragon
effect: If your opponent controls a creature, you may summon this card for 1 AP less than its listed cost.

name: Asst. Keye
effect: When summoned, you may summon any number of creatures from your hand whose combined ATK or combined DEF totals 3 or less.

name: King's Greed
effect: Draw 2 cards. (Playtest)

name: Tip the Scales
effect: Double your current momentum. Reset your momentum to 0 at your End Phase.

name: Enchanted Sword
effect: Equip to a creature you control. It gains +1 ATK. You may spend additional AP on activation to increase the ATK bonus by that amount instead.

name: Queen's Demand
effect: One creature you choose may attack twice this combat. It cannot block until your next Refresh.

name: Copy Conscious
effect: Destroy a creature you control. Add its ATK or DEF to another creature on the field.

name: Duo-Reverse
effect: When your opponent activates a Reaction, negate its activation and destroy the card.

name: Invisible Sword
effect: Equip to a creature you control. Its attacks now deal Piercing damage.

name: Resuscitate
effect: Target a creature from either player's discard pile and summon it to your field.

name: Revocation
effect: Send any number of creatures you control to the discard pile. Your opponent mills cards from the top of their deck equal to the combined AP cost of the discarded creatures.

name: Freeze Wave
effect: Your opponent cannot activate Reactions until the start of their next turn.

name: Burn
effect: Spend any amount of AP. Deal that much damage to a target creature. If the damage equals or exceeds its DEF, it is destroyed.

name: Downgrade
effect: When you block an attacking creature, reduce its ATK by your remaining AP after this card's activation.

name: Fool's Fortune
effect: When you take direct damage, add that amount as Temp AP to your next Refresh. Temp AP is spent first and vanishes at your End Phase.

name: Counterspell
effect: When your opponent activates a Magic card, negate its activation and destroy it.

name: Panic Button
effect: When you have no creatures on your field and a direct attack is declared, summon a creature with a cost of 2 AP or less from your hand to your field.

name: Spike Pit
effect: When your opponent declares an attacker, destroy that creature before blockers are declared.

name: Upload
effect: When a creature you control is destroyed by an opponent's creature in combat, draw 1 card.

name: Bounce
effect: When a creature attacks, return it to its owner's hand.

name: Thunder Robber
effect: When your opponent attacks and you declare a blocker, add the attacker's ATK to your blocker's DEF.

name: Royal Ceasefire
effect: When your opponent declares an attack, end it and refund their AP cost. They cannot attack again this turn.

name: Thank You Card
effect: Play after your opponent's Refresh step. Track the AP they spend until their End Phase. Add that amount as Temp AP to your next turn. Temp AP is spent first and vanishes at your End Phase.

name: Drafted
effect: Add any creature from your deck or Discard Pile to your hand. (Playtest)

name: AP Vanisher
effect: When this card is summoned, you can summon an additional creature with an AP cost of 4 or lower from your Hand or Discard Pile ignoring it's AP cost.(Playtest)
